# Sri Ranga Mahaal

> With Sri Vallabha Ganapathy's blessings — a fully air-conditioned wedding hall for 500 seated and up to 1,000 guests, opposite Senthil Nagar bus stop.

Website: https://srirangamahaal.com/

## Key facts
- the year we began 2004
- 1,000 guests floating, 500 seated
- 250 seats in the dining hall
- 7 A/C rooms with attached bath

## Facilities
- Fully air-conditioned

- Valet parking
- 6 LED TVs for video
- Air coolers for stage
- 14 more A/C rooms on rent

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sri Ranga Mahaal hold?
Sri Ranga Mahaal seats 500 guests in the auditorium, with up to 1,000 floating, and around 250 at a time in the dining hall.

### Where is Sri Ranga Mahaal?
Plot No 1, 2, 3, 4, Ranga Garden, Kolathur, Chennai 600 099 (Opposite Senthil Nagar Bus Stop).

### What facilities does Sri Ranga Mahaal have?
Fully air-conditioned, Bride & groom rooms, 2 Maharaja chairs, Ornamental traditional lamps, Kitchen with store room, Vessels for 3,000+ people, Uninterrupted power supply, Lift & CCTV, Valet parking, 6 LED TVs for video, Air coolers for stage, 14 more A/C rooms on rent.

### Can our guests stay nearby?
Yes. Sri Ranga Inn, at the same address, has 14 fully air-conditioned rooms on rent.

### Can you arrange catering and decoration?
Yes — catering, photography, flower, stage and hall decoration, nadaswaram, lighting and more can be arranged.

### How do I check if Sri Ranga Mahaal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 76678 77931.
